# Legals365

> > Comprehensive legal services across intellectual property, corporate compliance, family law, and litigation throughout Delhi NCR and India.

Legals365 provides specialized legal representation across courts in Delhi NCR (Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad) and the Supreme Court of India. The firm handles trademark and copyright matters, cybersecurity compliance, tax regulations, consumer protection, family law disputes, and criminal defense including terrorism cases.

## Key Topics

- Intellectual Property (Trademark & Copyright)
- Delhi NCR Legal Services
- Divorce & Family Law
- Cybersecurity Contracts & GDPR/CCPA Compliance
- GST & Direct Tax Compliance
- Supreme Court Representation
- Consumer Protection Act 2019
- Global Trademark Clearance
- Virtual Digital Assets (Crypto & NFT) Tax
- Licensing Agreements
- Cheque Bounce (Section 138 NI Act)
- UAPA & Terrorism Defense
- M&A Due Diligence
- Business Contracts & NDAs
- Court Representation (Tis Hazari, Karkardooma, Patiala House)
